name: Gatekeeper (Crooked Tooth Hurler)
comment: A Gatekeeper's Realm variant (user, research/lmoxide-notes/gatekeeper-variants.md): look medieval_ogre_hurler_ranged_summon_war 355217. npc_template 2391 is one of the client's 14 "Gatekeeper" names (TDB 51000), paired in order (a guess); level 15 and 7x a regular level-15 enemy's life (boss rank) are guesses. Throws gremlins (319947: npc/summoned-gremlin where it lands, 3.5–10 m away, every 4 s, up to 5 alive). Also his spin throw (439790: a projectile hitting everyone within 2 m where it lands, ×1.0; its ability animation 160451 may be the chest pound the user remembers). And his smash up close (319946 XX_Smash, the spell next to his throw: a 4 m frontal slam, its ability animation probably the chest pound the user remembers).
